what_this_was: Weekly forecasts of how named lenders' FHA denial behaviour would move (a projected change and a STABLE or REACTIVE signal per lender), written by a scheduled job from 2026 until 2026-11-24.
why: This site does not forecast the behaviour of named lenders. The page that showed these forecasts was retired on 2026-11-28; the job that kept writing this file was found the same day and stopped.
